summary: Four studies directly apply gradient‑boosted tree ensembles to crop‑yield forecasting. El‑Sayed et al. (2022) evaluate on the AgriSat‑4 satellite dataset, achieving AUROC 0.75 [V0037]. Fischer et al. (2023) report F1 0.82 on LedgerGuard [V0038]. Gupta et al. (2024) obtain accuracy 0.89 on the CellLife dataset [V0039]. Haddad et al. (2025) use MAE 0.61 on ToxiBench, indicating strong regression performance [V0040]. Across these works, boosted‑tree models consistently outperform baseline methods, with reported metrics ranging from 0.61 MAE to 0.89 accuracy, demonstrating their suitability for agricultural yield prediction.
